glosses: Full of woe; sorrowful; distressed with grief or calamity.

examples.text: How many woeful widows left to bow / To sad disgrace!

Thou seest we are not all alone unhappy:
This wide and universal theatre
Presents more woeful pageants than the scene
Wherein we play in.
What woful stuff this madrigal would be / In some starv'd hackney sonneteer or me!
